members.name: ReadFrame
members.signature: public TextureHandle ReadFrame(TextureHandle handle, TextureState usage = TextureState.Sampled)

docs.summary: Reads a texture a frame feature exported.
Reads the scene's depth, normals, and roughness and metallic.
Draws onto the current colour: the scene with its depth and G-buffer, or the last colour a feature wrote.

Draws onto the scene with its depth and G-buffer, as opaque and transparent geometry does. When a feature wrote a new colour since the scene was last drawn, that colour is copied into the scene first.
Writes a new colour from the current one, which later features read. [`Fullscreen`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Rendering.FeatureContext~Fullscreen) draws it.

Writes a new colour at the view's output resolution from the current one, as an upscaler does. Later features see the view at the output resolution, and the present draws it as it is. Only features in the Upscale slot can.

Says the colour this feature writes or draws is display encoded, as a tonemapper's is, so the present undoes the encode for targets that take linear light, sRGB and float ones. Later features keep it so.

members.name: History
members.signature: public TextureHandle History(string name, GraphTextureDesc desc, int frames = 1, TextureState usage = TextureState.Attachment)

docs.summary: A texture for this feature that keeps its last frames, read through [`History`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Rendering.FeatureContext~History). It is kept for each view. Usage adds Sampled for a feature that reads it back in the same pass it draws it.

Asks for the visible renderables whose materials have a pass of this type, the shader pass tagged "LightMode" = type, for [`DrawPass`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.DrawPass) to draw: opaque ones in bucket order, then transparent ones back to front. Any pass type works; the first time one is asked for, every renderable of the world is bucketed for it. Prepass and Forward are the built in opaque lists.
Declares the feature records the view's renderables or sky through the context's Draw methods, or draws lit programs, which read the view's lights, shadows and probes.

members.name: WriteScreenLighting

docs.summary: Writes the view's screen lighting, which renderables drawn after read through Graphite_IndirectDiffuse and Graphite_IndirectSpecular: visibility always, irradiance with its confidence when asked. Its size is set by the feature's [`Scale`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Rendering.ScreenLightingFeature~Scale). Returns the textures to draw, irradiance null when not asked.
